Five people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, on misdemeanor charges and holding charges, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search. An arrest is an allegation, and each person is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Rene Gilberto Leyva

Leyva, booking #202608903, was arrested at 3:33 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Cases 2022CRB000314L1 and 21PD001877 were listed on the record. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Raul Joel Herrera de Jesus

Herrera de Jesus, booking #202608902, was arrested at 3:22 p.m. on a charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond amount or case number was listed. The record shows an out-of-county hold.

Eddie Rico

Rico, booking #202608901, was arrested at 3:15 p.m. on a federal violation. The booking record did not specify the charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. He is being held by the United States Marshals Service.

Jimena Riojas

Riojas, booking #202608899, was arrested at 2:46 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor, Case #PFCC26-003311L2. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Mariela Capetillo

Capetillo, booking #202608898, was arrested at 2:41 p.m. on a charge of harassment, a Class B misdemeanor, Case #PFCC26-003310L2. Bond was set at $1,000.

The arresting agencies were not listed in the booking records.
